import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int INF = 2000 * 1000 * 1000;
    static final int S = MAXN - 2;
    static final int T = MAXN - 1;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] b = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] used = new boolean[15][15];
    static MaxFlow maxFlow = new MaxFlow();

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] to = new int[MAXM];
        int[] flow = new int[MAXM];
        int[] cap = new int[MAXM];
        int lastEdge;
        ArrayList<Integer>[] g;
        boolean[] used = new boolean[MAXN];

        MaxFlow() {
            lastEdge = 0;
            g = new ArrayList[MAXN];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            this.to[lastEdge] = to;
            this.flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            this.cap[lastEdge] = cap;
            g[from].add(lastEdge++);

            this.to[lastEdge] = from;
            this.flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            this.cap[lastEdge] = 0;
            g[to].add(lastEdge++);
        }

        boolean dfs(int v, int T, int curFlow) {
            if (v == T) return true;
            used[v] = true;
            for (int idx : g[v]) {
                if (!used[to[idx]] && cap[idx] - flow[idx] >= curFlow &&
                    dfs(to[idx], T, curFlow)) {
                    flow[idx] += curFlow;
                    flow[idx ^ 1] -= curFlow;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int getMaxFlow(int S, int T) {
            int curFlow = 1 << 30;
            int resFlow = 0;
            while (curFlow > 0) {
                if (dfs(S, T, curFlow)) {
                    resFlow += curFlow;
                } else {
                    curFlow >>= 1;
                }
                Arrays.fill(used, false);
            }
            return resFlow;
        }
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n &&
               0 <= y && y < n &&
               a[x][y] != 'Y' &&
               a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{x, y});

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int curx = cur[0], cury = cur[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && dist[tx][ty] == INF) {
                    dist[tx][ty] = dist[curx][cury] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{tx, ty});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        boolean[][] used = new boolean[n][n];
        used[x][y] = true;
        q.add(new int[]{x, y, 0});

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int curx = cur[0], cury = cur[1], curlev = cur[2];

            if (Character.isDigit(b[curx][cury]) && b[curx][cury] != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, n * n + 1 + curx * n + cury, INF);
            }

            if (curlev >= t) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && !used[tx][ty]) {
                    if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev + 1) {
                        q.add(new int[]{tx, ty, curlev + 1});
                    } else if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev && Character.isDigit(b[tx][ty]) && b[tx][ty] != '0') {
                        maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, n * n + 1 + tx * n + ty, INF);
                    }
                    used[tx][ty] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build() {
        int posi = -1, posj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && posi == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n && posi == -1; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    posi = i;
                    posj = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsDeath(posi, posj);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(S, i * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j]) && b[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(i * n + j + n * n + 1, T, b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    runBFS(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        t = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume rest of first line

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        scanner.nextLine(); // consume blank line

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        build();
        System.out.println(maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
